summary: [spec-fidelity] The brief's F3 acceptance says the largest safe integer 9007199254740991 passes; atip.input13.07 and .08 only show it is not an integer-range fault, using --round / a round document value, whose domain then refuses it with USAGE (the test finds the non-fault by a message substring and reason != INVALID_VALUE). An argument whose domain admits it exists: canon finding list --change b --limit 9007199254740991 answers ok (I ran it), and 9007199254740992 is refused beyond 2^53-1. The behavior is right; the check would not notice an off-by-one that moved the bound by one below the domain of round. Blast radius: the integer check of every leaf, shared by all of them.
